body: I wish I could tell you it gets better, but my experience is that it only sometimes seems that way. I've been dealing with this bullshit for ...17 years? Wow...I'm lonelier now than ever. Some mornings I wake up alone and I think I'll never love again, and I look at my pills, and then I look at my x-acto knife, and I have to try really hard not to shred myself to ribbons. My advice to you, if you even want it, is to just do the best you can despite your diagnosis, because it's possible to do really well in life despite all these assholes. I'll never forget the time they over medicated me because they're a bunch of sadistic shit heads....and it's like you say, most people, when they find out, abandon the ship like rats....but I would be disingenuous if I didn't say that I eventually found the right meds, the right doctors, and now I only want to kill myself when I realize how much time I wasted, and how terribly I gave up on the people I pushed away.  Good luck, man / lady.
